**Key findings (zodiac-year effect):**

- Dragon years: mean annual return +25.7%  (n = 2 years, Welch t = +0.84, Bonferroni-p = 1.000).
- Other 11 animals: mean +8.1%.
- Permutation null: 23.9% of randomly chosen animals are as 'lucky' as Dragon.
- **Effective n per animal ~3. No test on n=3 is meaningful regardless of the t-stat.**

## Verdict

- **Signal -- NONE.** Pre-CNY HAC t indistinguishable from zero on both FXI and ^GSPC. Zodiac-year effect: n ~3 per animal, no Bonferroni-corrected p clears 0.05. Tiny n makes any apparent Dragon premium pure noise.
- **Tradability -- MIRAGE.** No signal to trade; turnover and spread on pre-CNY window trades would bury any sub-1% observed premium.
- **Lucky Dragon? -- Busted.** 12 animals x ~3 years is structurally too small to ever clear the inference bar. The permutation null confirms Dragon has no special standing in a fair draw.
